verdict.rationale: HumanLayer's workflow-phases doc shows tiered approaches (Oneshot for low-risk changes vs. more review for unclear/risky changes) and skills-workflows lets users select Oneshot/RPI/PRD-Oriented/Freeform modes, which map to different levels of autonomy vs. oversight. However, there's no explicit documentation of a formal 'autonomy level' setting per agent/task with configurable confirmation thresholds, and no independent evidence confirming this tiered control works as an oversight mechanism in practice. missing for 10: explicit named autonomy-tier configuration (e.g., low/medium/high) tied to confirmation gating, evidence of engineering-lead-level policy controls across a team, and independent/hands-on validation that these workflow phases actually reduce unnecessary confirmations without sacrificing safety.
